summary: Implemented only surviving Pro proposal 3 as the fully frozen nonsemisimple multiplication fold over F_2[u]/(u^16). Exact enumeration on ten YES and 200 NO q=3,m=8 dictionaries gave worst YES distance 4 and best NO distance 2 at maximum active output length 17, inverting the gap to 1/2 and giving rank exponent zero versus the unfurled 0.2447428. The complete all-eight dictionary has the explicit pointed corner-only output word of moving weight zero. This finitely kills the specified label rule, not every nonsemisimple algebra fold.
hypothesis: Causal mechanism: assign each triple the frozen unit a_j=1+u^{h_j}+u^{2h_j+1}, with h_j=1 plus its canonical incidence-column value modulo 7, and map each ordered reduced-square coordinate to the coefficients of a_i a_j. Expected move: nilpotent valuation layers keep YES images sparse while spreading every NO mixed square in only 16 coefficient coordinates. Falsification condition: a pointed kernel, best NO no larger than worst YES, hostile collapse, or failure to beat the unfurled rank exponent. The experiment triggered all relevant failures: all-eight has a pointed kernel and the main finite gap is inverted.
